blocks.text: The PAW Patrol are on a roll in their rescue vehicles! Join Skye on action-packed missions with her helicopter! When trouble strikes, clip Skye’s feet in the cockpit and roll to the rescue with real working wheels and a movable propeller! Featuring authentic detailing and realistic features, the PAW Patrol’s beloved pilot and her PAW Patrol vehicle bring all excitement of the show to life. Skye and her toy vehicle are eco-consciously manufactured and are made from at least 65% pre-consumer recycled plastic! Team up with the rest of the PAW toy figures and their rescue vehicles (each sold separately) and help save the day in Adventure Bay! PAW Patrol preschool toys & toddler learning toys are gifts for kids who are fans of the show, fostering imaginative pretend play and enhanced fine motor skills. Relive your favorite moments from PAW Patrol seasons, like the Mighty Pups and PAW Patrol Movie, then create your own adventures with the PAW Patrol pups and their respective toy cars (each sold separately). Elevate the excitement with the complete Action Pups & Air Rescue team sets, which include PAW Patrol vehicles, action figures & toddler toys, for endless hours of PAWsome, series-inspired adventures!

items.label: COLLECTIBLE SKYE FIGURE
items.value: This helicopter includes a collectible Skye toy figure. Wearing her signature pilot’s uniform, Skye is ready to save the day

items.label: PAW PATROL TOY HELICOPTER
items.value: Clip Skye into the cockpit of her helicopter toy, that features authentic detailing, working wheels and a movable propeller, before racing off on a thrilling rescue mission

items.label: SUSTAINABLY MINDED TOY
items.value: Skye & her PAW Patrol toy car are made from at least 65% pre-consumer recycled plastic. Kids can explore their imagination, creating missions with their favorite pup

items.label: COLLECT THEM ALL
items.value: For more fun, collect all the PAW Patrol toys like the Air Rescue kids toys, PAW Patrol movie toys, dragon toys, stuffed animals, toy figures and playsets (each sold separately)

items.label: Learning and Education Toys
items.value: PAW plush toys and toy cars are toys for boys and girls that enjoy building toys Great gifts for kids 3 and up, as an alternative to dolls, dinosaur toys or a train set

items.label: Character
items.value: PAW Patrol, Skye’s Helicopter, Toy Vehicle with Collectible Action Figure, Sustainably Minded Kids Toys for Boys & Girls Ages 3 and Up
